title.tagline: Six friends booked the cheap route past a black hole.

cine.caption1: By 2189 nobody is just human any more. Five alien lineages married into ours, and the group chats have never been worse.
cine.caption2: Six friends on a tourist liner, and not one adult on board.
cine.mission2: DESTINATION: MILKY WAY GALACTIC CENTRE OBSERVATION CORRIDOR
cine.line1: Imagine if we actually find aliens.
cine.line2: Bro. Look at us. We are the aliens.
cine.line3: The centre of the galaxy, with you lot. This trip is giving main character energy.
cine.montage: Day 41: beyond the edge of charted space
cine.line5: That reading is impossible. Gravity doesn't do that.
cine.ai1: WARNING. UNIDENTIFIED GRAVITATIONAL DISTURBANCE DETECTED. NAVIGATION SYSTEMS EXPERIENCING ANOMALOUS DEVIATION.
cine.ai2: CRITICAL FAILURE. STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY: 41%. PROPULSION: OFFLINE. EMERGENCY PROTOCOL INITIATED.
cine.line7: Pods! Everyone to the pods, now!
cine.line8: Hold on to something! Hold on to me!
wake.line1: Ow. Okay. Either I'm dead, or this is a one-star stay on Trapadvisor.
wake.line2: Two worlds in the sky. That is not our Moon. That's nobody's Moon.
wake.line3: Hello? Squad? {f:social}? {f:strong}? Bro, even the group chat is dead.
wake.line4: Something is moving between the trees. Something huge. Nope. Nope nope nope.
wake.line5: Stay calm. Think like a scientist. Scientists drink water. Step one: don't die.
level.1.title: Find Water
level.1.desc: Your suit's water reserve is empty. Find a source of water and drink.
level.1.hint: Your suit sensor detects moisture. Follow the marker on the compass.
level.2.title: Find Food
level.2.desc: Your strength is fading. Find something you can safely eat.
level.2.hint: Strange fruit grows near the water. Examine before you eat.
level.3.title: Collect Stones and Branches
level.3.desc: Gather 5 stones and 5 branches. You will need them to make tools.
level.4.title: Make Fire
level.5.title: Build a Shelter
level.6.title: Craft a Spear
level.7.title: Survive the First Night
level.8.title: Find the Signal
level.9.title: Reunite with {f:explorer}
level.10.title: Light the Beacon
medic.hint: You remember {f:medic}, the Medic: “Never eat what you can't identify. Thorns and oily skins mean poison. Test a small piece first, rub it on your skin and wait.”
fruit.examineBlue: Smooth skin, a soft blue glow, a faint sweet smell. No reaction on your skin. Probably safe.
fruit.examineRed: Hard thorns and an oily red skin. Your fingers tingle where you touched it. Bad idea.
fruit.ateBlue: Sweet and strange: like pear and pepper. Your body accepts it.
fruit.ateRed: Your stomach cramps violently. That was a mistake.
msg.drink: Cold, metallic, clean enough. The suit filter agrees.
msg.drinkFull: You are not thirsty right now.
msg.deep: Too deep. You can't swim in this suit.
msg.thirsty: Your throat is burning. You need water.
msg.night: Night is falling. Bioluminescence wakes up across the forest.
death.title: YOU DID NOT SURVIVE
death.text: You died. Try not to do that bit again.
objectives.title: Objectives: The First 24 Hours
crew.title: The Crew
crew.note: Find your friends to unlock their skills.
crew.scientist.name: Zenvik
crew.scientist.line: {lin}. Two doctorates. Can explain a black hole, cannot open a jar.
crew.strong.name: Draxum
crew.strong.line: Korrath-human from the foundries of Titan. Claims three hundred aura points. Cries at adverts and will deny it.
crew.medic.name: Lyrra
crew.medic.line: Vael-human from the garden domes of Mars. Has never raised her voice. Her sarcasm has a licence.
crew.explorer.name: Skyvra
crew.explorer.line: Tarnkin-human from the ice caravans of Ganymede. Always on a side quest. Keeps a ledger of who owes her snacks.
crew.builder.name: Bolzar
crew.builder.line: Ortek-human from the shipyards of Ceres. Says everything he builds will hold. Allegedly.
crew.social.name: Nuvexa
crew.social.line: Sirelle-human from the cloud cities of Venus. Forty million followers and one real friend group.
level.4.desc: Night is coming. Gather dry moss for tinder, build a fire pit at your camp and strike stones until a spark catches.
level.4.hint: Your camp site glows near the pod. Dry moss grows in the open clearing.
level.5.desc: Cut giant fronds and gather branches, then build a lean-to beside the fire.
level.5.hint: Giant fronds grow at the edge of the forest.
level.6.desc: Something hunts here at night. Lash a flint point to a straight branch with glowvine.
level.6.hint: Flint shards lie among the rocks; glowvine coils on the ground under the trees.
level.7.desc: Rest at the shelter until dark. When the predator comes, brace your spear as it charges. Then sleep until dawn.
level.7.hint: Press [[interact]] the moment it snarls and charges, not before.
level.8.desc: Your wrist device picked up a crew signal, too weak to locate. Climb to the crystal ridge and tune it.
level.8.hint: The higher you climb, the stronger the signal.
level.9.desc: Follow the signal to the second escape pod. Help whoever you find there and bring them back to camp.
level.9.hint: Follow the marker and the smoke from the second pod.
level.10.desc: Salvage your pod's transmitter, gather metal scrap for a reflector, assemble a beacon at camp and switch it on.
level.10.hint: Metal scrap from your pod lies scattered along the crash furrow.
level.arc.title: Chapter Two Complete
level.arc.desc: Eleven discoveries down, and the voice in the beacon has seen them all before. The Bronze Age comes in a future build. Explore, trade and make more at camp.
level.arc.toast: End of Chapter One. Chapter Two starts at camp.

msg.pitBuilt: Stones in a ring, branches stacked like a tent. Now a spark.
msg.strike1: Sparks jump into the moss… and die.
msg.strike2: A thin curl of smoke. Again.
msg.fireLit: Fire! You can see your hands again, and the dark backs off a bit.
msg.shelterBuilt: A lean-to of branches and giant fronds. It'll keep the rain off.
msg.spearCrafted: Flint lashed to a straight branch with glowvine. You feel a little less like prey.
msg.restDusk: You rest by the fire while the light fades…
msg.sleeping: You crawl into the shelter and close your eyes…
msg.houndNear: Eyes in the dark. Six of them.
msg.houndHit: The spear finds its mark. It shrieks and backs off.
msg.houndBit: It bites and darts back into the dark!
msg.houndMiss: You stab at empty air. Wait until it charges.
msg.houndFled: It's gone. For now. Sleep while you can.
msg.slept: You wake at dawn. Stiff, cold, and alive.
msg.transmitter: You pull the emergency transmitter out of the pod. Its battery still holds a charge.
msg.beaconBuilt: Tripod up, transmitter mounted, scrap panels as a reflector.
msg.crewFollow: {f:explorer} is following you. Lead the way back to camp.
msg.crewAtCamp: {f:explorer} sinks down by the fire with a long sigh.
signal.detect2: TOO WEAK TO LOCATE · SEEK HIGH GROUND
dlg.7.1: I've got fire and a spear. My stats are kind of mid, but I'll take it. Now I wait for the dark.
dlg.8.1: A crew signal! Too weak from down here. Great. Looks like I'm doing cardio.
dlg.8.found: {f:explorer}! She's alive. Hold on, I'm coming. I'll even pay the snack debt.
memory.explorer: You remember {f:explorer} on the observation deck, laughing: “If we ever crash somewhere, I'm the one who finds the way home. You just bring the snacks.”
dlg.9.1: Is someone there? {f:scientist}?! If you're a hallucination, you still owe me snacks.
dlg.9.2: I'm real. Bad news: so is the debt. Are you hurt?
dlg.9.3: My leg is cooked. And I've been listening to that giant thing walk all night. I named it Greg.
dlg.9.4: Hold still. Branch and vine. I watched a Tiktak about this once.
dlg.9.5: Ow! That video was not accurate! Okay. Okay. Lead the way.
dlg.9.6: A real fire. {f:scientist}, you might actually be a genius. Don't let it go to your hair.
dlg.10.1: Every pod has an emergency transmitter. Pull yours, find scrap, we build a beacon. It's giving civilisation.
dlg.10.2: If anyone else survived, they'll hear it.
dlg.10.3: They're alive. All of them. {f:scientist}, they're alive!
dlg.10.4: Origin: Earth? None of us has ever even been to Earth.
dlg.10.5: That isn't a crew channel. That signal is older than our ship.
beacon.1: BEACON ONLINE · TRANSMITTING ON ALL CREW CHANNELS
beacon.unknown1: INCOMING · SOURCE UNKNOWN · BENEATH YOUR POSITION
beacon.unknown3: “…YOU WERE NOT THE FIRST TO ARRIVE.”

vo.anon.memory.explorer: You remember the Explorer on the observation deck, laughing: “If we ever crash somewhere, I'm the one who finds the way home. You just bring the snacks.”

vo.anon.dlg.9.1: Is someone there? Is that you?! If you're a hallucination, you still owe me snacks.
vo.anon.dlg.9.6: A real fire. You might actually be a genius. Don't let it go to your hair.
vo.anon.dlg.10.3: They're alive. All of them. They're alive!
inv.title: Inventory
inv.note: Materials are used automatically when you build or craft at a station.
itemdesc.stone: Fist-sized and heavy. Fire pits, tools.
itemdesc.branch: Dry, straight wood. Fire, shelter, spear shafts, splints.
itemdesc.fruit: Glowpod: blue, sweet, safe to eat.
itemdesc.tinder: Dry moss that catches a spark.
itemdesc.frond: A giant leaf, tough and waterproof. Roofing.
itemdesc.flint: A sharp shard that holds an edge.
itemdesc.vine: Glowing, stretchy cord for lashing things together.
itemdesc.scrap: Hull plating from your pod. Reflectors, frames.
itemdesc.spear: Flint, branch and glowvine. Brace it when something charges.
itemdesc.transmitter: The pod's emergency transmitter. Still holds a charge.
tut.complete: Training complete. You can replay it from Settings.
tut.look.kbm: [[look]] Move the mouse to look. Click to lock the cursor.
tut.move.touch: Put your left thumb down and push to walk
tut.sprint.touch: Push the stick to the rim to run
tut.interact.kbm: Follow the diamond. [[interact]] picks things up.
tut.interact.touch: Follow the diamond. The big button changes to [[interact]] when something is in reach.
op.1: Okay besties, squad selfie, galactic core in the back. {f:strong}, chin down, your horns are photobombing.
vo.anon.op.1: Okay besties, squad selfie, galactic core in the back. Big guy, chin down, your horns are photobombing.
op.2: Bro. The horns are the aura.
op.3: Your aura just blocked the emergency exit.
op.4: Who ate my snacks? {f:scientist}. Look me in the eyes.
vo.anon.op.4: Who ate my snacks? You. Yes, you. Look me in the eyes.
op.5: Technically the snacks were communal. I have a spreadsheet.
op.6: He has a spreadsheet. We're cooked. He has been cooked since Europa.
op.7: Relax. I tightened the big window myself. It'll hold.
op.8: You said that on Ceres. That is why I carry three kinds of burn cream.
op.9: Straight on Snapgram. Caption: six lineages, one brain cell.
op.11: Me. It's always me. Which is why nobody asked how I got us this route for free.
op.12: Wait. Free? You said Lamazon Orbit had a sale.
op.13: It was lowkey a beta route. Unlisted. Slightly closer to the centre.
op.14: Bro. You booked us a side quest at a black hole.
op.15: It's an observation corridor. Perfectly safe. No cap.
op.16: You said no cap. That is how I know it's cap.
op.17: Guys. Why are the stars moving?
op.18: That reading is impossible. Gravity doesn't do that.
op.19: Okay. Not funny. {f:scientist}, tell me this is a prank.
vo.anon.op.19: Okay. Not funny. Tell me this is a prank.
op.20: It's not a prank. Everyone, get away from the glass.
vo.anon.op.21: Hey! You still owe me snacks!
vo.anon.wake.line3: Hello? Squad? Anyone? Bro, even the group chat is dead.
dlg.4.1: Ancient people did this with rocks. I have two doctorates. How hard can it be.
dlg.4.3: Zero stars. Would not strike again. Lamazon lied about this survival kit.
dlg.4.4: Fire! I am literally the main character! And nobody saw it. Of course nobody saw it.
fb.1: A memory, arriving uninvited. Day thirty-nine. The fight nobody posted.
fb.2: You're not even listening, bro. Nine days staring at that screen.
fb.3: Because the numbers are wrong, and nobody here can count past their follower count!
fb.4: Wow. Okay. Say that again, Mister Spreadsheet. Say it to my face.
fb.5: Enough. We have forty days of corridor left and one bathroom.
fb.6: He thinks he's better than us. Lab people always do.
fb.8: Hey! He's my idiot, not yours. Group hug or I'm airlocking the snacks.
fb.9: The friendship, I mean. It'll hold.
fb.10: I never said sorry. If you're out there, {f:strong}, I'm sorry.
vo.anon.fb.10: I never said sorry. If you're out there, big guy, I'm sorry.
dlg.7.2: That's six eyes. Six. Why does it need six.
dlg.7.3: Aura points: plus one thousand. I am shaking. But plus one thousand.
dlg.9.7: I thought I was the only one left.
dlg.9.8: Me too. I talked to Greg for a whole day. Terrible listener. I'm really glad it's you.
rad.strong: Bro. Bro! Is that you? I've been wrestling a tree for two days. The tree is winning.
rad.medic: I've catalogued nine poisonous plants without eating any. Tell {f:builder} to stop licking things.
vo.anon.rad.medic: I've catalogued nine poisonous plants without eating any. Tell our builder to stop licking things.
rad.builder: Your beacon's a bit crooked. Sounds like it, I mean. But it'll hold.
rad.social: Besties! One percent battery, and I look incredible.
dlg.10.6: Wait. Your wrist log. Course change, authorised by you. {f:scientist}, why is your name on this?
vo.anon.dlg.10.6: Wait. Your wrist log. Course change, authorised by you. Why is your name on this?
dlg.10.7: What? No. I booked a corridor. I never touched navigation.
dlg.10.8: Look at me. No jokes. Did you bring us here on purpose?
dlg.10.9: I swear on every snack I owe you. I don't know who used my login.
dlg.10.10: Okay. I believe you. Lowkey terrified, but I believe you. So who did?
mz.intro.1: Oh good. Another one. Wipe your feet. This is the edge of a black hole and I have just had it cleaned.
mz.intro.2: I am MegaZroN, keeper of the Last Ledger. I write down how every story ends. Yes, yours. No, you may not see it.
mz.intro.3: Six friends are about to have the funniest day of their lives. Then the worst. It's a tight schedule.
mz.intro.4: Everything you do goes in here. Who you trust, and how many times you walk into a tree.
mz.intro.5: Go on, then. Try to surprise me. Nobody has in nine thousand years, but I do love watching people try.
mz.l3.1: Food and sticks. The oldest speedrun in the universe, and you have finished it. Slowly.
mz.l3.red: You ate the thornberry. After it tingled. I have underlined that in the Ledger. Twice.
mz.l3.safe: You examined the fruit before eating it. How disappointing. I had already sharpened my pencil.
mz.l3.died: And you have already died. Lovely. My favourite chapter is the one that restarts.
mz.l3.hint: A free hint, since you look tired. Dry moss likes open sky. You should try it.
mz.l3.2: Night is coming. Light a fire and keep it lit. You'll see why.
mz.l7.1: You survived a night. Most pages in this room stop around there, so: mild applause.
mz.l7.clean: Not one bite! That hound went home and told all six of its eyes about you.
mz.l7.bitten: It bit you. It reports that you taste of burnt coffee and poor planning.
mz.l7.2: Now listen to your wrist. Signals carry further in the cold, and not all of them want to be found.
mz.l7.hint: Go up. It's always uphill on this planet.
mz.ch1.1: The beacon is lit. Four friends answered. So did something that read your family tree like a menu.
mz.ch1.names: You renamed your crew. Sweet. Something down there already has their real names, and has had them for a very long time.
mz.ch1.nonames: Six names, six signals. Keep them close. Something down there collects names.
mz.ch1.2: Subjects: six. Origin: Earth. Funny, isn't it? Not one of you has ever stood on Earth. And yet you were recognised.
mz.ch1.3: Ninety-nine steps lie between you and the truth. Every one has been walked before. Check the footprints. Check the shoe size.
mz.ch1.4: See you next chapter, little traveller. I'll keep your seat warm. I always do.
mz.name: MegaZroN
j.1: Mum texted. 'Reached? Ate? Wear a jacket.' Twenty-six thousand light-years, and she still has signal.
j.2: If one more person says six-seven, I am sedating the entire group chat.
j.3: Task failed successfully. That's my whole engineering career, in one sentence.
j.4: Water. Flavour: two stars. Hydration arc complete. Touch grass achievement unlocked, sadly.
j.6: Respawn granted. This time, try using the eyes you were issued.
j.7: Greg walked past again. He's giving landlord energy.
j.8: In my day we walked to the singularity uphill, both ways, on dial-up.
j.9: We are six. Seven, counting my biceps.

npc.trader.hi: Welcome to Lamazon Rock Delivery. Two branches, one flint. No refunds, and this planet has no returns desk.
npc.trader.done: Pleasure. Five stars, please. I have a family of rocks to feed.
npc.trader.no: No branches, no deal. This is capitalism with extra steps.
npc.local.hi: Small warm one. You walk loud. The ground has filed a complaint.
npc.local.ask: Bring one stone. I give one vine. We call this economy. You call it please.
npc.local.done: Good. You may continue being loud.
npc.hermit.1: You'll stop at ninety-nine. They always do. Sorry, wrong century.
npc.hermit.2: I've met you before. You were taller. You also owed me snacks.
npc.trav.1: Excuse me, is this the queue for the refund desk? I've been here nine years.
npc.trav.2: My review will be brutal. One star. That one, up there, and it is leaving.
npc.cameo.1: Sorry, is this the eleven o'clock? I was told business casual.
npc.cameo.2: I don't know how I got here either. But the lapels are holding.

legal.terms: BEYOND SAGITTARIUS is a free game by megazron. Play it and share links to it for personal use. Don't resell it or publish modified copies without permission. It comes with no warranty: it may have bugs, change or go offline, and saves can be lost. To the extent the law allows, megazron is not liable for loss or damage from using it.
legal.privacy: No accounts, adverts, analytics or tracking of our own. Your save, settings and character stay in local storage on your device. The web version is served by GitHub Pages, which sees your IP address and browser details. The desktop app makes no requests of its own.
legal.safety: Do not try this at home. The science is simplified for a game and is not instructions. Made for a general teen audience: comic horror, peril and mild creature violence. Younger players should play with a parent or guardian.
legal.parody: Characters and events are made up. Names such as Lamazon are invented parodies used for humour. No real company is involved or endorses this game.

codex.knapping.text: Flint breaks in smooth curved shells, not along grain. Strike the edge at the right angle and a flake comes off sharper than most knives.
codex.knapping.joke: Three million years of tech, and it's a rock hitting a rock. Same as my gym routine.
codex.cordage.text: Twist fibres and friction holds them. Twist two strands against each other and each one's urge to unwind locks the other. Short fibres become strong rope.
codex.cordage.joke: Two weak things pulling against each other and somehow getting stronger. That's literally our group chat.
codex.fire.text: Fire needs fuel, heat and oxygen. Friction heats wood dust until it smoulders into an ember. Feed it dry tinder and air, and the ember becomes flame.
codex.fire.joke: Lovely. Burns are my second favourite injury. Please stop giving me a favourite.
codex.pottery.text: Wet clay is tiny flat crystals sliding on water. Fire drives that water out of the crystals for good, so the pot can never turn back into mud. Grit in the clay stops cracks.
codex.pottery.joke: First container on the planet. Zero warranty, lopsided, no lid. Ship it.
codex.charcoal.text: Heat wood with very little air and it can't burn away. Water and gases leave, and nearly pure carbon stays. It burns far hotter and cleaner than wood.
codex.charcoal.joke: You burned wood to get better wood. I have written this in the Ledger as progress. In pencil.
codex.lime.text: Strong heat drives carbon dioxide out of limestone and leaves quicklime. Add water and it gets hot and turns to slaked lime, which slowly takes the gas back and sets like stone.
codex.lime.joke: Rock that turns to paste and back to rock. Finally, a material with my commitment issues.
codex.salt.text: Salt is dissolved in brine as charged particles. Drive off the water and they lock back into crystals. Salt keeps food by pulling out the water that microbes need.
codex.salt.joke: We're salty now. Officially. It's in the codex.
codex.glass.text: Sand melts only at huge heat, but plant ash lowers that, and lime makes the result last. Cool it fast and the atoms freeze with no time to line up. That's glass.
codex.glass.joke: Beaker first, lens later, and one day real stitches. Please don't name the first one after yourself.
codex.soap.text: An alkali from ash splits fats into soap molecules. One end loves water, the other loves oil. They wrap around grease so that water can carry it away.
codex.soap.joke: Soap has saved more lives than I ever will. I'm not crying. Go wash your hands.
codex.fermentation.text: Yeast eats sugar when there is no oxygen, and gives off alcohol and carbon dioxide. Too hot and the yeast dies. That's why a brew has to stay warm, not hot.
codex.fermentation.joke: So tiny things eat, burp and that's science? Bro, I've been a chemist my whole life.
codex.acids.text: With air, bacteria turn alcohol into sour vinegar, a weak acid. Acids give up hydrogen ions and bases take them. Mix the two and they cancel. Lichen dye shows which side you're on.
codex.acids.joke: A moss that tells you what's wrong with your drink. Finally, someone on this planet with standards.

itemdesc.nodule: Raw flint from the ridge, with a chalky skin. Knapping stock.
itemdesc.fibre: Long stringy fibres from lakeside reeds.
itemdesc.sand: Clean pale sand from the shore. Mostly silica.
itemdesc.limestone: Soft pale rock from the ridge.
itemdesc.brine: Salty water from a seep below the ridge.
itemdesc.ash: Pale ash raked from around the fire. Alkaline.
itemdesc.oilnut: A greasy nut. A source of fat.
itemdesc.sugarpod: Sticky sweet pod. Yeast loves it too.
itemdesc.lichen: Its dye changes colour with acids and bases.
itemdesc.blade: A flake with a frightening edge.
itemdesc.lime: Caustic white powder. Mortar, glass, tests.
itemdesc.salt: Keeps food. Tovik takes it as money.
itemdesc.glass: A cloudy lump of the first glass on this planet.
itemdesc.brew: Bubbling. Not for you. Vinegar stock.
itemdesc.vinegar: A weak acid. Sour proof of chemistry.
level.11.title: Make an Edge
level.11.desc: Everything on a starship began with a sharp rock. Fetch flint nodules from the ridge and a hammerstone, then knap a blade at camp.
level.11.hint: Flint nodules are in the rocks up on the ridge. Skyvra at camp can talk you through it.
level.12.title: Twist a Cord
level.12.desc: Glowvine snaps when it dries. Gather reed fibre by the lake and twist real cord.
level.12.hint: Reeds grow at the lake shore. Oom-Sa knows the trick, if she can stand you.
level.13.title: Fire on Demand
level.13.desc: One lucky spark is not a technology. Build a bow drill and make fire on purpose.
level.13.hint: You need branches, dry moss and your cord.
level.14.title: Fire Some Clay
level.14.desc: Dig clay at the shore, add sand for grit, then fire it into pots.
level.14.hint: Clay and sand are at the lake. Ask Oom-Sa why pots crack.
level.15.title: Make Charcoal
level.15.desc: Wood fire is too weak for what comes next. Smother a wood stack under clay and keep it smouldering.
level.15.hint: Stack branches, seal with clay. Tovik sells a tip, naturally.
level.16.title: Burn a Rock
level.16.desc: Roast limestone in a charcoal fire, then slake it with water to make lime.
level.16.hint: Limestone is on the ridge. Yuvax has opinions about it.
level.17.title: Boil Out Salt
level.17.desc: Collect brine from the seep below the ridge and drive off the water in a pot.
level.17.hint: Heat it gently, or the crystals spit and scorch.
level.18.title: Melt Sand
level.18.desc: Sand, ash, lime and the hottest fire you can manage. Make the first glass on this world.
level.18.hint: Ash lies around the fire pit. Yuvax trades a tip for salt.
level.19.title: Make Soap
level.19.desc: The crew smells like a crash site. Combine ash lye with oilnut fat.
level.19.hint: Oilnuts drop in the forest near camp.
level.20.title: Let It Ferment
level.20.desc: Food that lasts, medicine that works: both need microbes on your side. Mash sugarpods in a pot and keep them warm.
level.20.hint: Sugarpods grow in the forest. Pello may have some, for a price.
level.21.title: Sour and Bitter
level.21.desc: Let air turn the mash to vinegar, then balance it against lime using lichen dye.
level.21.hint: Litmoss lichen grows on the ridge rocks.
level.arc2.toast: End of Chapter Two. Thank you for playing.
progress.ch2Ready: Everything gathered. Start the work at camp.
progress.remake: Short of {list}. Ask Skyvra to make more.
msg.taught: Learned a trick for {name}. It will go easier.
mg.keys.tap: Space or the button, when the marker is in the band
mg.keys.hold: Hold Space or the button to raise it, let go to lower it
mg.keys.alt: Alternate A and D, or the two buttons, at a steady pace
mg.keys.mix: A and D or the buttons adjust it. Space or Done when it looks right
mg.tap.miss: Bad angle. The blow just crushed the edge
mg.failed: Ruined. You keep the materials, and MegaZroN keeps the receipts.
disc.head: Discovery
mg.knapping.0: Hit near the edge at a sharp angle. A blow square to the face only crushes it.
mg.cordage.0: Roll the fibres one way, lay the two strands the other. Keep it even.
mg.fire.0: Saw the bow in long even strokes until the dust smoulders.
mg.fire.1: Blow on the ember, gently. Air feeds it. Too hard and it scatters.
mg.pottery.0: Work sand into the clay. Too little grit and it cracks, too much and it crumbles.
mg.pottery.1: Bring the fire up steadily and hold it. Rush it and steam bursts the pot.
mg.charcoal.0: Keep the stack smouldering under clay. Too much air and it all burns to ash.
mg.lime.0: Hold the kiln very hot for a long time. The rock must give up its gas.
mg.lime.1: Now add water, little by little. It heats up on its own.
mg.salt.0: Warm the pot gently. You want evaporation, not a violent boil.
mg.salt.1: Stir so the crust keeps breaking and the water can leave.
mg.glass.0: Balance sand against ash and lime. The ash lowers the melting point.
mg.glass.1: The narrowest band yet. Charcoal and moving air, right at the top of what you can reach.
mg.soap.0: Balance alkali against fat. Too little and it stays greasy, too much and it stays harsh.
mg.fermentation.0: Thin the mash with water. Too sweet slows the yeast, too thin starves it.
mg.fermentation.1: Keep it warm, never hot, and leave the gas a way out.
mg.acids.0: Stir air into the mash. The vinegar bacteria need oxygen.
mg.acids.1: Add lime until the dye sits between red and blue. That is neutral.
fail.1: That was not science. That was an accident with a witness.
fail.2: Failed. I have sharpened a fresh quill for this.
fail.3: Humanity took a hundred thousand years on this. You may have five more minutes.
teach.knapping: Flint from the ridge, one hammerstone, and hit the edge, not the middle. Your rock, your fingers.
after.knapping: That's sharp. Okay, nerd. Respect. Tiny respect.
teach.cordage: Reeds at the lake. Twist one way, wrap the other. It's a friendship bracelet with consequences.
after.cordage: This cord could hold my leg together better than your splint did. Rude of it.
teach.fire: Bow, spindle, dry moss. Long strokes. No panic. I know, I'm asking a lot.
after.fire: Fire, on purpose. Our ancestors would be proud. Mine would ask why it took so long.
teach.pottery: Lake clay, some sand, then fire. Skip the sand and it pops like my knee.
after.pottery: A pot! We can carry water without crying. This is the most luxury I've had in days.
teach.charcoal: Stack wood, bury it in clay, leave a little breath. Starve it, don't kill it.
after.charcoal: Black, light, and it rings when you tap it. Next you'll say metal needs this. Right?
teach.lime: Pale rock from the ridge goes in the charcoal fire. Keep your eyes and skin far from the powder.
after.lime: You cooked a rock, and it hissed at you. Same energy as my aunt's pressure cooker.
teach.salt: Seep below the ridge, tastes like tears. Boil off the tears, keep the salt. Very therapeutic.
after.salt: Salt! Now the hound jerky might last the week. Also Tovik just started sweating.
teach.glass: Sand, ash, lime, charcoal, and more air than feels sensible. Stand back, then back again.
after.glass: You melted the beach and I can see through it. Okay. That one actually got me.
teach.soap: Ash water plus oilnut grease. It's the only reason I'll still sit next to you.
after.soap: It's ugly, it's lumpy, it smells of campfire, and I would die for it.
teach.fermentation: Mash sugarpods, keep the pot warm, and don't seal it. Trust me on not sealing it.
after.fermentation: It's bubbling by itself. Tiny roommates. They pay rent in gas.
teach.acids: Let the mash breathe till it turns sour, then balance it with lime. The lichen is the judge.
after.acids: Sour, bitter, balanced. We just did chemistry with a moss referee.
ch2.intro.1: Nobody's coming. If we want off this rock, we build the ship ourselves.
ch2.intro.2: Ship needs chips. Chips need glass and metal. Metal needs fire. So, rocks. We start with rocks.
ch2.intro.3: Nine ages of science, one idiot. Good luck, everybody.
ch2.beacon.pottery: Vessel. Same shape as last time.
ch2.beacon.glass: Ahead of schedule. Do not be proud.
ch2.beacon.react: Okay, that's the beacon talking. I hate that. Keep working.
ch2.end.1: Salt. Soap. Vinegar. The same order. It is always the same order.
ch2.end.2: Always? Who else has been doing this?
ch2.end.3: Next: metal. They always want metal.
ch2.end.4: It knows what we'll make before we make it. So we make something it doesn't expect.
chapter2.end2: It is always the same order
mz.ch2.1: Eleven discoveries. In a row. Without a single adult. I have checked the Ledger twice.
mz.ch2.clean: And you barely failed. Suspicious. Who has been helping you?
mz.ch2.messy: Yes, you ruined quite a lot of clay. It is all in here. Every lump.
mz.ch2.2: Fire, then pots, then lime, then glass. It is a good order. It is a very familiar order.
mz.ch2.3: Metal next, little chemist. I have turned the page. It was already written on.
g.f.mz.ch2.clean: And you barely failed. Suspicious. Who has been helping you?
g.f.mz.ch2.3: Metal next, little chemist. I have turned the page. It was already written on.
ch.voice: What is the voice in the beacon?
ch.lime: How do you burn a rock?
ch.glasstip: Trade 1 salt for a glass tip
dlg.nothing: You have nothing to make yet.
npc.trader.back: Lamazon Rock Delivery. Same day, or same century. What'll it be?
npc.trader.dead: Frequent dier! I've moved you to our premium plan. Nothing changes, but it costs more.
npc.trader.salt: You made salt? In my territory? Fine. Salt is money now. I hate how much I respect you.
npc.trader.menu: Today's catalogue. Everything is final sale, including you.
npc.trader.q: My stock smells of cave. Bring one soap and I'll pay in premium sand.
npc.trader.qdone: Five stars. I smell like a brand now. Here's your sand.
npc.trader.tip: Free advice costs extra. Wood burns away with air. Choke the air, keep the wood. Thank you for shopping.
npc.local.dead: You fell down dead again. The ground says you are heavy.
npc.local.soap: You smell less loud. The ground has withdrawn its complaint.
npc.local.cord: One way for the hair, other way for the rope. Each wants to undo. Together they cannot. Like your family.
npc.local.clay: Pure clay is proud. It breaks. Give it grit. Small warm one, you could also use some.
npc.local.q: My people keep water in leaves. It is bad. Bring me one of your fire-bowls.
npc.local.qdone: Good bowl. Ugly. Good. Take this moss. It knows sour from bitter, which is more than you do.
npc.hermit.dead: You died again. Fewer times than last time. Don't let it go to your head.
npc.hermit.voice: It counts. That's all it does. I answered it once. Don't.
npc.hermit.lime: Burn it long and hot. The rock breathes out. Then water makes it scream. You always flinch at that part.
npc.hermit.glass: Charcoal alone won't do it. Move the air. Same as last time. Same as every time.
npc.hermit.soon: You always ask that before you've made it. Go and find out.
npc.trav.refund: The refund desk. It opens soon. The sign says soon. The sign has said soon for nine years.
npc.trav.dead: You died? And they let you back in? I've been asking for that upgrade for years.
npc.trav.soap: Is that soap? Amenities! I'll raise my review. To one star and a half.
npc.trav.q: A queue needs a stanchion. Bring me a clay pot and I'll give you my complimentary welcome fruit.
npc.trav.qdone: Perfect. Here, welcome fruit. It's been fizzing in my bag, so the brochure says keep it warm, not hot.
g.f.npc.trav.dead: You died? And they let you back in? I've been asking for that upgrade for years.
g.f.npc.local.dead: You fell down dead again. The ground says you are heavy.
g.f.npc.local.clay: Pure clay is proud. It breaks. Give it grit. Small warm one, you could also use some.
g.f.npc.hermit.dead: You died again. Fewer times than last time. Don't let it go to your head.
g.f.npc.hermit.lime: Burn it long and hot. The rock breathes out. Then water makes it scream. You always flinch at that part.
g.f.npc.hermit.soon: You always ask that before you've made it. Go and find out.
sk.hi: Still alive, genius? What do you need?
sk.dead: You keep dying and I keep doing the funeral speech. It's getting really good.
sk.fails: I heard that last attempt from here. So did the ridge. Want a hint?
sk.leg: Holding. Your splint is ugly and it works. Don't let that define you.
sk.done: We're out of plans for now. Make extra, trade, stay alive. I'm watching the beacon.
rad.ch2.strong: Tree update. It's me, one. Tree, two. Best of five. Keep working, nerd.
rad.ch2.medic: I've rationed the bandages. Wash everything. If you don't have soap yet, invent it.
rad.ch2.builder: Found a hull section. Needs welding, so you've got about four thousand years of homework.
rad.ch2.social: No signal, no followers, and something here keeps liking my posts. By that I mean it's breathing near me.
g.f.sk.dead: You keep dying and I keep doing the funeral speech. It's getting really good.
map.note: Contours every 9 m. Your pod's chart, so don't trust it past the ridge.
settings.bindPressPad: Press a button on the controller.
tut.menu.kbm: Tap [[inventory]] for your items, hold it for the wheel. [[map]] opens the map.
tut.menu.touch: [[pause]] has the map, your items and the crew
film.explorer: Worst part? Nobody paid me back.
br.res.early: You got here fast. I had a whole speech ready about you being late. Wasted.
g.f.br.res.early: You got here fast. I had a whole speech ready about you being late. Wasted.
br.res.late: Took you long enough. I said goodbye to Greg twice.
br.splint.fail: Ow! Greg stomps once and you let go? Again. Properly this time.
br.fire.ask: A big fire, the others might see it from miles off. So might Greg. Your call.
br.fire.big.r: That's the most reckless thing you've ever said. I'm into it.
br.acc.doubt: I want to believe you. I really do. Give me a minute to actually manage it.
br.acc.proof.r: Nobody's ever just handed me the whole thing. Okay. We read it together.
br.acc.joke.r: I said no jokes. Okay. Now I know what you do when you're scared. Or when you're guilty.
g.f.br.acc.joke.r: I said no jokes. Okay. Now I know what you do when you're scared. Or when you're guilty.
br.acc.silent.r: Nothing. Okay. Nothing is an answer too.
br.fire.big: Build it up. Let them see it. Greg can leave a review.
br.fire.small: Keep it low. Staying alive first, being found second.
br.acc.proof: Here. Take the whole log. Read every line. I've got nothing to hide from you.
br.acc.joke: Obviously. I hijacked a whole liner for the free breakfast.
br.rad.medic.truth: Channel's still open. I heard all of it. Your voice never shakes when you lie. It's shaking now. So, good.
br.rad.medic.joke: Channel's still open. A joke? Right now? I'm writing that on your chart.
br.rad.medic.silent: Channel's still open. Why did you go quiet? Somebody say something.
g.f.br.rad.medic.silent: Channel's still open. Why did you go quiet? Somebody say something.
br.rad.strong.truth: Bro. If you say it wasn't you, it wasn't you. We'll find who it was. Me and the tree.
g.f.br.rad.strong.truth: Yo. If you say it wasn't you, it wasn't you. We'll find who it was. Me and the tree.
br.rad.strong.joke: Ha! Okay, that was good. Wait. Was that a yes? Bro, was that a yes?
g.f.br.rad.strong.joke: Ha! Okay, that was good. Wait. Was that a yes? Yo, was that a yes?
br.rad.strong.silent: You? Quiet? You've never been quiet in your life. Now I'm actually scared.
g.f.br.rad.strong.silent: You? Quiet? You've never been quiet in your life. Now I'm actually scared.
br.rad.builder.smoke: Saw your smoke from here, by the way. Beacon's still crooked. But it'll hold.
npc.trav.hungry: Nine years in this queue, and nobody has offered me so much as a biscuit.
npc.trav.fed: Is this complimentary? Five stars. I'm putting your name in the review.
npc.trav.pay: Found this in the queue. Someone dropped it in year four. It's yours now. I kept your place, too.
npc.trader.honest: You're giving it back? On this planet? I'll have to tell the rocks.
npc.trader.pay: Lamazon Rock Delivery. One vine, an order you never placed. Honest customers get the premium route.
npc.trader.short: My stock came up one flint short. Strange, that. The price is three branches now.
mz.br.truth: You told her the truth. In this room that is rarer than a quiet black hole. It won't save you, but I wrote it down.
g.f.mz.br.truth: You told her the truth. In this room that is rarer than a quiet black hole. It won't save you, but I wrote it down.
mz.br.proof: You handed her the log. All of it. I keep eleven thousand volumes, and very few people do that.
mz.br.joke: She asked you a real question and you did a bit. I laughed. She didn't. Only one of us has to live with you.
mz.br.silent: You chose to say nothing. Silence is still ink. It just dries slower.
mz.br.timeout: You let the clock answer for you. The clock has been wrong before. It never apologises.
mz.br.kind: You gave half your food to a man in a queue. Nobody saw. I see everything. It is very tiring.
mz.br.fair: You handed back a flint nobody would have missed. Strange behaviour. I've made a note.
mz.br.kept: You kept the extra flint. Small sums are how my longest books begin.
mz.br.late: {f:explorer} waited a long time for you. She won't say so twice. She doesn't have to.
mz.br.hint.pello: Someone near the second pod is very hungry and very polite. I mention it only because I am nosy.
mz.br.hint.tovik: You are carrying something that isn't yours. It is small. Those are the ones that weigh the most.
mz.br.rec.honesty: So far your page reads honest. An inconvenient habit, out here.
mz.br.rec.mercy: So far your page reads kind. The universe hasn't noticed. I have.
mz.br.rec.nerve: So far your page reads brave. That word means foolish until the last chapter.
mz.br.rec.humour: So far your page reads funny. Every joke you make, I will read back to you at the end.
mz.br.rec.none: So far your page reads blank. Blank pages are the ones I worry about.
br.acc.title: The accusation
br.acc.lock.proof: She would have to trust you already.

br.splint.title: The splint

br.pello.toast: A piece of scrap, wrapped in a queue ticket.

br.end.d.stay.together: They stay because they believe you.
br.end.d.stay.alone: You stay. Nobody asked you to.
